info.name: Lattice Reviews API
info.description:
Operations tagged Reviews across 2 of this provider's published API definitions: lattice-hris-openapi.yml, lattice-talent-openapi.yml. Each path carries the servers of the definition it was published in.

Contact Support:
 Name: Lattice Developer Support
 Email: customercare@lattice.com
